leakage_rules: All explicitly designated equivalence-group siblings are kept in the same split.
All explicitly designated hard-negative-group members used for paired evaluation are kept in one split.
Families are intentionally shared across dev and held-out; this is NOT unseen-family evaluation.
Compiler prompts may be tuned only on dev.
Held-out outputs are one-shot for a frozen compiler/configuration.
Future dialogue from temporal forks must never be visible at the prefix compile cutoff.
held_out_notes: Held-out contains three major semantic contrast clusters: layoff attribution/commitment, Beijing travel status/obligation/conditional, and outage sarcasm/literal statement.
Held-out temporal forks test inventory and pickup obligations under divergent later outcomes.
